name: Colorado stonecrop
desc: Colorado stonecrop (Sedum spathulifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 459 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sedum spathulifolium is a species of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae known by the common names broadleaf stonecrop, yellow stonecrop, and spoon-leaved stonecrop.
